display_name: DURA 与正交恢复器的源域频段误差诊断
description: 在 672 个相同源 IQ 样本上按绝对频率比较 DURA 和两个源训练冻结恢复器，不读取 F、TX、V 或目标，不训练模型。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 GPU7, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7, FP32 TF32 off, batch 32

data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 frozen source pilot physical IDs, RX4/6 and RX8 by seven views; read indices/rx/scene/split only

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored fixed source pilot; RX8 is source held group, not independent to DURA

permissions.claim_scope: Source IQ frequency decomposition, not identity accuracy and not independent evaluation

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen DURA and frozen source-only orthogonal IQ / guard models, fixed final epoch
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original DURA source contract plus each fixed source summary and checkpoint commit, objective, F/TX/target permissions
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen source-only Phase1 IQ checkpoints; no F weights or target-derived selection
checkpoint.selection_rule: Two already trained source-only candidates, irrespective of future ground results

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU7, one this-run worker, at most three total compute workers; preserve others
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role mismatch, source smoke failure, nonfinite output or any target/F/TX read; preserve stopped group and other owners.

expected_artifacts: result.json with mean four-band errors and correction energies for 14 source groups

metric_names: four-band error energy normalized by clean IQ energy
four-band correction energy normalized by clean IQ energy

rows.method: Orthonormal complex FFT per-window decomposition for frozen DURA and two correction networks
rows.purpose: Locate source error and correction energy across frequency bands
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.
rows.budget_ref: 672 source IQ pairs including two-record real-checkpoint smoke, batch 32

notes: Source IQ groups previously examined and not independent of DURA.
No model updates, F model or F output, TX labels, V, target or user-stopped tasks touched.
Source smoke runs first in same process.
